source: Hand-curated from JLPT N3 frequency lists, common Japanese corpora, and pitfalls observed in N4→N3 learners.
notes: A focused 500-word target deck of N3-level vocabulary that learners need to bridge from N4 textbook Japanese into real-world reading and listening. Cards lean toward words an N4 learner has seen but cannot yet use actively: abstract nouns, transitive/intransitive verb pairs, common -する verbs, frequency adverbs, and common な/い adjectives. Words covered in the existing N4/N5 Core, N3/N4 General, Japan Travel, or Yotsubato decks are intentionally excluded to avoid overlap. This is volume 1 of 500 — additional cards will be added in future passes; the current build covers the highest-frequency essentials first.

cards.context: 荷物を預ける — to check/leave luggage. Pairs with 預かる (to look after for someone).
鍵を預かる — to keep someone's key. Other side of 預ける.
More formal than あげる. Used for impact/influence: 影響を与える — to have an influence on.
商品を扱う — to deal in (a product). Also 大切に扱う — to handle with care.
集中する — to concentrate. 集中力 — powers of concentration.
子供を育てる — to raise children. Pairs with 育つ.
Intransitive of 育てる. 田舎で育った — I grew up in the countryside.
計画を進める — to push a plan forward. Don't confuse with 勧める (to recommend).
Intransitive of 進める. 工事が進む — construction is progressing.
Same reading as 進める but different kanji. 本を勧める — to recommend a book.
塩を加える — add salt. 仲間に加える — bring into the group.
Intransitive pair of 加える. チームに加わる — to join a team.
税込み — tax included (literally 'tax-containing'). 含めて — including.
Transitive form. 子供も含めて20人 — 20 people including children.
Often written 越える for 'cross over'. 1万円を超える — to exceed 10,000 yen.
Used for crossing physical things: 山を越える, 国境を越える.
背が伸びる — to grow taller. 麺が伸びる — noodles get soggy.
Transitive of 伸びる. 髪を伸ばす — to grow out one's hair.
膝を曲げる — to bend one's knees. Pairs with 曲がる.
右に曲がる — to turn right. Intransitive of 曲げる.
骨を折る — to break a bone (also idiomatically: to take pains). 紙を折る — to fold paper.
骨が折れる — a bone breaks; also figuratively 'requires effort'.
約束を破る — to break a promise. 記録を破る — to break a record.
Intransitive. 紙が破れる — the paper tears.
Math: 10を2で割る — divide 10 by 2. 卵を割る — crack an egg.
Intransitive. ガラスが割れる — the glass breaks.
魚を焼く — to grill fish. 焼ける is the intransitive.
日に焼ける — to get a suntan. 家が焼ける — the house burns down.
お湯を沸かす — to boil water. Pairs with 沸く.
お湯が沸いた — the water has boiled.
ビールを冷やす — chill the beer. Pairs with 冷える.
体が冷える — to feel chilled. 冷えた飲み物 — chilled drink.
スープを温める — heat up the soup. Also 暖める for room/body warming.
雪が溶ける — the snow melts. 氷が溶ける — ice melts.
雨で濡れた — got wet in the rain.
洗濯物が乾く — laundry dries. Pairs with 乾かす.
髪を乾かす — to dry one's hair.
服が汚れる — clothes get dirty.
床を汚さないで — don't dirty the floor.
プレゼントを包む — to wrap a present.
荷物を運ぶ — carry baggage. 順調に運ぶ — to proceed smoothly.
書類を渡す — to hand over documents. Pairs with 渡る.
橋を渡る — to cross a bridge.
家を探す — house hunting. 仕事を探す — job hunting.
ボールを投げる — throw a ball.
ドアを叩く — knock on the door. 手を叩く — clap hands.
ボタンを押す — press a button. ハンコを押す — stamp a seal.
辞書を引く — look up in a dictionary. 風邪を引く — to catch a cold.
重い荷物を持ち上げる — to lift a heavy bag.
カバンから本を取り出す — take a book out of the bag.
電池を取り替える — replace the batteries.
家具を組み立てる — assemble furniture.
色を組み合わせる — combine colors.
ページを飛ばす — to skip pages. Transitive of 飛ぶ.
問題から逃げる — to run from a problem.
チャンスを逃がす — to miss a chance.
夢を追う — to chase a dream.
More active than 追う. 犯人を追いかける — chase a criminal.
バスが通る — a bus passes by. 試験に通る — to pass an exam.
客を通す — show a guest in. 目を通す — to look over.
故郷を離れる — to leave one's hometown.
手を離す — let go of one's hand.
締め切りが近づく — the deadline approaches.
Transitive form. 顔を近づける — bring one's face close.
家に戻る — go back home. Less formal than 帰る.
本を棚に戻す — put the book back on the shelf.
手紙が届く — a letter arrives. 手が届く — within reach.
荷物を届ける — to deliver a package.
会社に残る — to stay at the office. 記憶に残る — stay in memory.
食べ残す — to leave food uneaten.
ストレスが溜まる — stress builds up. 仕事が溜まる — work piles up.
お金を溜める — to save money. Often written 貯める for money.
家を建てる — build a house. Different from 立てる ('to stand up').
新しいビルが建つ — a new building is being built.
部屋を飾る — to decorate a room.
商品を並べる — display goods on shelves.
レジに並ぶ — line up at the cashier.
目を閉じる — close eyes. 本を閉じる — close a book. More literary than 閉める.
店を開く — open a shop. パーティーを開く — hold a party. Reading ひらく vs あく — different nuance.
気持ちを伝える — convey feelings. よろしくお伝えください — please give my regards.
うわさが伝わる — a rumor spreads. 気持ちが伝わる — feelings get across.
先生に教わる — to be taught by a teacher. Counterpart of 教える.
質問に答える — answer a question. The noun 答え means 'answer'.
質問する — to ask a question. 質問はありますか — any questions?
説明する — to explain. 説明書 — instruction manual.
報告する — to report. 報告書 — written report.
発表する — to announce/present. プレゼン uses this concept.
自己紹介 — self-introduction. 紹介する — to introduce.
道案内 — directions. ご案内します — I'll show you the way.
注意する — to warn / pay attention. 注意点 — point to be careful about.
反対する — to oppose. 反対方向 — opposite direction.
賛成する — to agree with. Opposite of 反対.
意見を言う — to give an opinion. ご意見ありがとうございます — thank you for your input.
主張する — to insist, claim. Stronger than 意見.
発言する — to speak up, make a remark. Used in formal settings.
日常会話 — everyday conversation. Different nuance from 話 (general 'talk').
討論会 — debate session. More formal than 議論.
議論する — to discuss/argue. Often used in news/business.
翻訳する — to translate (text). Distinct from 通訳 (interpretation, spoken).
通訳する — to interpret (spoken). Also refers to the person doing it.
発音が難しい — pronunciation is difficult.
Often written 噂. うわさを聞く — to hear a rumor.
嘘をつく — to tell a lie. Also exclamation: 嘘! 'No way!'
本当に — really. Casual ほんと is everywhere in spoken Japanese.
事実上 — in effect. More formal than 本当.
実際に — actually, in reality. 実際の話 — the actual story.
確かに — certainly. 確か… — if I recall correctly… (hedging).
確実な情報 — reliable information. Stronger than 確か.
必ず行きます — I will definitely go. Stronger than きっと.
きっと来ます — I'm sure they'll come. Speaker's strong belief.
Often written 多分. Common hedge — weaker than きっと.
More formal than たぶん. Often paired with でしょう.
もしかして山田さん? — Could you be Yamada-san?
More emphatic than もし. もしもの時 — in case of emergency.
絶対に行く — definitely going. 絶対に許さない — never forgive.
全く分からない — I don't understand at all. Also exclamation of frustration.
全部食べた — ate it all. Common, but the kanji can trip beginners.
一部の人 — some people. Opposite of 全部.
全体的に — overall, on the whole. 全体の半分 — half of the whole.
大部分の人 — most people.
100円以上 — 100 yen or more. 以上です — that concludes (used to end presentations).
以下の通り — as follows. 18歳以下 — 18 years old or younger.
一週間以内 — within one week.
日本語以外 — other than Japanese.
以前会ったことがある — we've met before.
以後気をつけます — I'll be careful from now on.
今後ともよろしく — please continue to support me. Business essential.
将来の夢 — dream for the future. Personal/career future.
More abstract than 将来. 未来予想 — predicting the future.
過去の経験 — past experience. Opposite of 未来.
現在の状況 — current situation. More formal than 今.
その瞬間 — at that moment.
期限を守る — meet the deadline. Distinct from 締め切り (more 'cutoff').
More formal than 年. 年齢制限 — age restriction.
次の世代 — the next generation.
90年代 — the 90s.
日付を確認する — check the date.
Often written 締め切り. 締切に間に合う — make the deadline.
電車に間に合う — make the train. Also 'be sufficient': これで間に合います.
延期する — to postpone. 試合が延期になった — match was postponed.
中止する — to cancel. Stronger than just 延期.
開始する — to start (an event, activity). More formal than 始める.
終了する — to end. Used for events, broadcasts, sales.
中断する — to interrupt/suspend. 試合中断 — match suspended.
再開する — to resume. After 中断 comes 再開.
成功する — to succeed. Opposite of 失敗.
失敗する — to fail. 失敗しないように — so as not to fail.
努力する — to make an effort. 努力家 — a hard-working person.
頑張って — Good luck/Hang in there. Universal Japanese encouragement.
工夫する — to devise. 工夫を凝らす — to put thought into.
応募する — to apply (for a contest, job). 応募者 — applicant.
レッスンに申し込む — sign up for a lesson. Different from 応募する in nuance.
申し込み書 — application form.
登録する — to register. Common online: アカウント登録.
会員登録 — member registration.
利用する — to use (a service/facility). サービスを利用する — use a service.
More formal than 使う. 使用禁止 — prohibited use.
消費する — to consume. 消費税 — consumption tax.
節約する — to economize. お金を節約する — save money.
無駄遣い — wasteful spending. 時間の無駄 — waste of time.
効率がいい — efficient. 効率的 — efficient (na-adj form).
効果がある — to have an effect. 効果的 — effective.
副作用 — side effect (medical/general).
第一印象 — first impression. 印象的 — impressive, striking.
性格がいい — has a good personality.
For substances or abstract nature. 化学的性質 — chemical properties.
Note: also in Japan Travel deck. Highly common — worth knowing in both contexts.
Same reading as 特徴 — different kanji means 'strong point' specifically.
Often paired with 短所 in interviews/self-introductions.
自分の短所 — one's own weaknesses.
音楽の才能 — musical talent.
能力試験 — proficiency test (as in JLPT 日本語能力試験).
知識を増やす — to increase one's knowledge.
常識がない — lacks common sense (mild insult).
知恵を貸す — to lend wisdom (to help solve a problem).
記憶力 — power of memory. 記憶に残る — to stay in memory.
想像する — to imagine. 想像力 — imagination (the faculty).
Same reading as 想像 but different kanji. 創造性 — creativity.
発明する — to invent. 発明家 — inventor.
発見する — to discover. Distinct from 発明 (creation).
研究する — to research. 研究者 — researcher.
アンケート調査 — questionnaire survey.
分析する — to analyze. データ分析 — data analysis.
判断する — to judge/decide. 判断力 — power of judgment.
評価する — to evaluate. 高い評価 — high rating.
批判する — to criticize. Distinct from 批評 (literary critique).
提案する — to propose. Business essential.
検討する — to consider. Soft business decline: 検討します = I'll think about it (often = no).
解決する — to solve. 問題解決 — problem-solving.
問題ない — no problem. Also test questions and social issues.
宿題 (homework) and 課題 differ — 課題 is more 'assigned task/issue.'
Common in school context, also figurative: 'unfinished business.'
試験を受ける — take an exam. JLPT itself is 日本語能力試験.
単語帳 — vocabulary book. Useful for self-talk: 単語が分からない.
文章を書く — to write prose. Bigger than 文 (a single sentence).
段落分け — paragraph divisions. JLPT reading section term.
新聞記事 — news article. ネット記事 — online article.
Note: also in N3/N4 General. 資料を準備する — prepare materials.
報道する — to report (in news). マスコミ報道 — media coverage.
テレビ放送 — TV broadcast. 生放送 — live broadcast.
テレビ番組 — TV show. 人気番組 — popular show.
画面が暗い — the screen is dark. Computer/phone screen.
画像を保存する — save an image. Digital pics.
音声ファイル — audio file. More technical than 声.
映像を見る — watch the video/footage. News reports often use this.
録画する — to record (video). 録音 is for audio.
録音する — record audio. Distinct from 録画.
パソコンの操作 — computer operation. 操作する — operate (machinery).
設定する — to set/configure. アプリの設定 — app settings.
ファイルを保存する — save a file. 保存料 — preservatives.
削除する — to delete. Common in tech contexts.
検索する — to search (online). ググる (slang) means the same.
情報を集める — gather information. 情報源 — information source.
通信費 — communication fees (phone/internet).
接続する — to connect. ネット接続 — internet connection.
自然環境 — natural environment. 仕事の環境 — work environment.
自然な感じ — natural feel. Also a noun.
温暖な気候 — warm climate. Distinct from 天気 (weather).
地球温暖化 — global warming.
宇宙飛行士 — astronaut.
地球は惑星です — Earth is a planet.
星を見る — stargaze. 五つ星 — five stars (rating).
太陽系 — solar system. More scientific than 日.
At N3 level: 月の光 (moonlight) — beyond just 'month.'
季節の変わり目 — change of seasons.
日本には四季がある — Japan has four seasons.
Irregular reading つゆ. 梅雨入り — start of the rainy season.
Sometimes also しっき. 湿気が多い — high humidity.
乾燥肌 — dry skin. 空気が乾燥する — air gets dry.
More formal than 天気. 天候不順 — unsettled weather.
地震が起きる — an earthquake occurs. Important for Japan!
津波警報 — tsunami warning. Loanword everywhere now.
洪水被害 — flood damage.
自然災害 — natural disaster. 災害対策 — disaster countermeasures.
避難する — to evacuate. 避難所 — evacuation shelter.
危険な道 — dangerous road. Sign warnings often say 危険.
安全第一 — safety first. Opposite of 危険.
交通事故 — traffic accident. 事故に遭う — to be in an accident.
怪我をする — to get injured. 大怪我 — serious injury.
Already at N5 level but worth being conscious of compounds: 病気になる — to get sick.
風邪が治る — to recover from a cold. Distinct from 直る (to be repaired).
病気を治す — cure illness. 直す for objects.
診察を受ける — get examined by a doctor.
治療を受ける — receive treatment.
手術を受ける — undergo surgery.
入院する — to be hospitalized. 退院 — discharge from hospital.
退院する — to be discharged.
Smaller than 病院. Also クリニック (loanword).
内科医 — internist. Compare 外科 (surgery).
外科医 — surgeon.
歯医者 (はいしゃ) — dentist. 歯科医院 — dental clinic.
症状を伝える — describe symptoms (at clinic).
頭痛がする — have a headache.
More formal than お腹が痛い.
発熱する — to develop a fever. More medical than 熱がある.
咳が出る — to have a cough. JLPT-rare kanji but common word.
鼻水が出る — have a runny nose.
Major topic in Japan. 花粉症の薬 — hay fever medicine.
卵アレルギー — egg allergy.
健康に気をつける — take care of one's health. Used as both noun and na-adj.
Beyond 'exercise' — also a 'movement': 環境運動 — environmental movement.
筋肉痛 — muscle pain (after exercise).
骨折 — bone fracture. 骨を折る (idiom: take pains).
血が出る — to bleed. 血液 (けつえき) is more medical.
More medical than 肌. 皮膚科 — dermatology.
肌が荒れる — skin gets rough. 肌色 — skin color.
心臓が悪い — have heart trouble. 心 is more for 'heart' as feeling.
胃が痛い — stomach hurts. Different from お腹 (abdomen).
肺がん — lung cancer.
脳の働き — brain function.
お年寄り is the polite form. 高齢者 is more formal.
News/government term. 高齢化社会 — aging society.
赤ちゃんが生まれる — a baby is born.
妊娠する — to become pregnant.
出産する — to give birth.
育児休暇 — childcare leave. Common workplace term.
教育を受ける — to receive education. 教育者 — educator.
大学に進学する — to enter university.
就職活動 (就活) — job hunting.
転職する — to change jobs.
退職する — to retire/quit. 退職金 — retirement bonus.
会議に出る — attend a meeting.
More casual/preparatory than 会議.
出張する — to go on a business trip.
残業する — to work overtime. 残業代 — overtime pay.
More formal than 休み. 有給休暇 — paid leave.
有給を取る — to take paid leave. Often shortened from 有給休暇.
勤務時間 — working hours.
通勤する — to commute. 通学 is for school.
通学路 — route to school.
職場の人 — workplace people.
Compare 部長, 課長 (specific titles).
Opposite of 上司.
Same level, same workplace.
営業部署 — sales department.
担当する — to be in charge of. 担当者 — person in charge.
責任を持つ — take responsibility. 責任者 — person responsible.
義務教育 — compulsory education.
権利を持つ — to have rights. 人権 — human rights.
自由に — freely. 言論の自由 — freedom of speech.
平和な国 — peaceful country. Opposite of 戦争.
戦争反対 — anti-war. Heavier than 喧嘩.
政府の対応 — government's response.
国民の声 — voice of the people.
市民会館 — city hall/civic center.
社会人 — working adult/member of society.
地域社会 — local community.
地方出身 — from the countryside (as opposed to Tokyo).
都市部 — urban areas. Opposite of 田舎.
田舎に帰る — return to the countryside/hometown.
都会の生活 — city life.
住民票 — resident certificate.
選挙に行く — to go vote.
投票する — to vote. 投票所 — polling place.
法律違反 — violation of law.
裁判所 — courthouse.
警察に届ける — to report to the police. 警察官 — police officer.
消防車 — fire truck. 消防士 — firefighter.
救急車 — ambulance. 救急室 — emergency room.
会社を経営する — to run a company.
Common form of address: 社長, 部長 etc.
Note: also in Japan Travel deck. 日本経済 — Japanese economy.
消費者保護 — consumer protection.
More formal than 値段. 定価 (ていか) — list price.
値段が高い — expensive. More casual than 価格.
電気料金 — electricity bill. Used for services.
税金を払う — to pay taxes. 消費税 — consumption tax.
請求書 — invoice. 請求する — to bill, demand.
支払いを済ませる — complete the payment.
レシート is informal. 領収書をください — receipt please (asked at restaurants).
貯金する — to save money. Distinct from 預金 (bank deposit).
借金がある — to be in debt.
年収 — annual income.
Opposite of 収入. 家計の支出.
外国通貨 — foreign currency.
両替する — to change money/break a bill.
商売をする — to do business. More everyday than ビジネス.
新商品 — new product.
日本製品 — Japanese-made products. Slightly more formal than 商品.
自動車工場 — car factory.
Standard label. サラリーマン is more colloquial.
Government employee. Stable career stereotype.
専業主婦 — full-time homemaker.
歴史学者 — historian.
小説家 (novelist) is more specific.
日本画家 — Japanese-style painter.
More formal than ミュージシャン.
プロ歌手 — professional singer.
新聞記者 — newspaper reporter.
政治家になる — to become a politician.
More formal than お医者さん. 医師免許 — medical license.
Replaced older 看護婦 (only female form). Now gender-neutral.
弁護士に相談する — consult a lawyer.
安藤忠雄は建築家だ — Tadao Ando is an architect.
More formal than 仕事. Used on official forms.
私の立場では — from my position. 立場が違う — different positions.
態度が悪い — bad attitude.
行動する — to take action. 行動範囲 — range of activities.
礼儀正しい — well-mannered.
テーブルマナー — table manners. Loanword.
敬語を使う — use polite language. 尊敬語/謙譲語 are subtypes.
です/ます is the basic 丁寧語.
流行する — to be trendy. 大流行 — huge trend.
伝統文化 — traditional culture. 伝統的 — traditional.
日本文化 — Japanese culture. 文化の違い — cultural differences.
早起きの習慣 — habit of waking early.
More personal/quirky than 習慣. 口癖 — verbal habit.
夏祭り — summer festival. お祭り is the polite form.
年中行事 — annual events.
宗教の自由 — religious freedom.
信仰心 — religious feeling.
歴史的な出来事 — historical event.
日本の昔話 — Japanese folktales.
竹取物語 — The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter.
都市伝説 — urban legend.
小説家 — novelist.
詩を書く — write a poem.
Note: also in Japan Travel deck. 芸術家 — artist.
美術館 — art museum. More 'visual art' than 芸術.
クラシック音楽 — classical music.
演劇部 — drama club.
映画館 — cinema. Already at N5 but examples worth knowing.
展示会 — exhibition. 展示する — to display.
代表作品 — representative work.
作者不明 — author unknown.
映画監督 — film director. 野球監督 — baseball coach.
At N3, it shifts from 'years old' into compounds: 天才 (genius), 才能 (talent).
後ろ姿 — view from behind. 姿を見せる — to show oneself.
形が変わる — shape changes. Also figurative: 'form' or 'system.'
本の内容 — the content of a book.
表面的 — superficial. 表面に出る — to come to the surface.
カバンの中身 — what's inside the bag.
裏側 — the other side. 裏切り — betrayal.
表に出る — go outside. Distinct reading: ひょう = table/chart.
奥さん — wife (literally 'inner one'). 奥深い — deep, profound.
山の頂上 — mountain peak.
地下鉄 — subway. 地下一階 — first basement floor.
屋根の上 — on the roof.
床に座る — sit on the floor.
壁にぶつかる — hit a wall (literal or metaphorical).
廊下を走らないで — don't run in the hallway.
階段を上る — go up the stairs.
玄関で靴を脱ぐ — take shoes off at the entryway. Cultural essential.
Where futons are stored during the day.
畳の部屋 — tatami room.
障子を開ける — open the shoji.
家具を買う — buy furniture.
家電 (かでん) is the shorter, more common form.
冷蔵庫に入れる — put in the fridge.
レンジで温める — heat in the microwave.
洗濯機を回す — run the washer.
掃除機をかける — to vacuum.
エアコンをつける — turn on the AC.
扇風機をつける — turn on the fan.
暖房を入れる — turn on heating. Opposite of 冷房.
冷房が効きすぎ — AC is too cold.
鍵をかける — lock the door.
折り畳み傘 — folding umbrella.
財布を落とす — drop one's wallet.
眼鏡をかける — wear glasses.
結婚指輪 — wedding ring.
宝石店 — jewelry store.
大工道具 — carpenter's tools.
機械が壊れる — the machine breaks.
More technical than 機械. 安全装置 — safety device.
自動車の部品 — car parts.
For cooking and construction. 材料を集める — gather materials.
金属アレルギー — metal allergy.
鉄道 — railway. 鉄分 — iron (nutritional).
For building. 木 alone = tree/wood generic.
紙を一枚 — one sheet of paper.
レジ袋 — plastic bag at the cashier. ビニール袋 — plastic bag.
段ボール箱 — cardboard box.
ビールの瓶 — beer bottle. 缶 — can.
缶ジュース — canned juice.
お皿 — plate (polite).
ご飯茶碗 — rice bowl.
鍋料理 — hot pot cuisine. Also the pot itself.
包丁を使う — use a kitchen knife.
At N3 the kanji 卵 is worth knowing.
絹豆腐, 木綿豆腐 — silken/firm tofu.
納豆ご飯 — natto over rice.
味噌汁 — miso soup.
醤油をかける — to put soy sauce on.
野菜を食べる — eat vegetables.
果物屋 — fruit shop.
More academic. Daily life: お米 (rice).
砂糖を入れる — add sugar.
塩辛い — salty. 塩を振る — sprinkle salt.
酢の物 — vinegared dishes.
サラダ油 — salad oil. Different reading 脂 = animal fat.
飲み物は何にしますか — What would you like to drink?
好きな食べ物 — favorite food.
料理する — to cook. 日本料理 — Japanese cuisine.
味が薄い — bland. 味見する — to taste-test.
いい匂い — nice smell. 臭い (くさい) is for bad smells specifically.
音が出る — make a sound. 騒音 — loud noise.
太陽の光 — sunlight.
影が長い — long shadow.
At N3 think compounds: 色々 (various), 顔色 (complexion).
花模様 — floral pattern.
赤い線 — red line. 線を引く — draw a line.
As suffix: 表面, 一面. As noun: 'aspect'.
次の角を曲がる — turn at the next corner. Reading かく for 'angle.'
道の端 — edge of the road. Different from 橋 (bridge), same reading.
穴を掘る — dig a hole. 穴があく — a hole forms.
ドアの隙間 — gap in the door.
周りの人 — people around you.
Already in Yotsubato deck (ご近所). 近所の店 — neighborhood shop.
頻繁に — frequently. More formal than よく.
普通の人 — ordinary person. Also 'local train' on JR (普通電車).
特別な日 — special day. 特別に — especially.
重要な点 — important point. More formal than 大切.
必要がある — to need to. 必要な物 — necessary things.
知識が豊富 — has abundant knowledge.
複雑な気持ち — complicated feelings.
単純な人 — a simple-minded person (sometimes negative).
簡単な質問 — easy question. Already common, important nuance vs 単純.
困難な状況 — difficult situation. More formal than 大変.
明確な答え — clear answer.
曖昧な返事 — vague answer. Common Japanese cultural concept.
正確な情報 — accurate information.
完全に — completely. 完全な答え — perfect answer.
十分な時間 — enough time. Often written 充分.
睡眠不足 — sleep deprivation. Opposite of 十分.
Tricky: can mean 'appropriate' OR 'haphazard.' Context matters.
急な変化 — sudden change. 急ぐ — to hurry. Already in N3/N4 General as adverb 急に.
穏やかな天気 — mild weather. Personality too: 穏やかな人.
At N3 think nuances: 静かに考える — to think quietly.
派手な服 — flashy clothes. Often slightly negative.
Opposite of 派手. 地味な人 — unassuming person.
豪華な料理 — luxurious meal.
質素な生活 — simple life. Opposite of 豪華.
贅沢な食事 — extravagant meal.
At N3, deeper sense: 優しい言葉 — kind words. Already at N5 but worth solid review.
厳しい先生 — strict teacher.
柔らかいパン — soft bread. Also figurative: 頭が柔らかい — flexible thinking.
硬いパン — hard bread. 固い is a near-synonym (firm).
鋭い質問 — sharp question. 鋭い感覚 — keen sense.
動きが鈍い — slow movements. Opposite of 鋭い.
濃いコーヒー — strong coffee. 関係が濃い — close relationship.
薄い味 — bland taste. Opposite of 濃い.
深い意味 — deep meaning. Both physical and abstract.
浅い知識 — superficial knowledge. Opposite of 深い.
細かい字 — fine print. お金が細かい — having small change.
粗い仕事 — sloppy work. Different from 荒い (wild).
激しい雨 — heavy rain. 激しく怒る — angry intensely.
恐ろしい話 — terrifying story. Stronger than 怖い.
恥ずかしい思いをする — to feel embarrassed.
Often heard alone as 懐かしい! when someone hears an old song. Untranslatable nuance.
羨ましい! — Lucky you / I'm jealous (positive).
何かおかしい — something's off. Also 'amusing.'
ややこしい問題 — tricky problem. Casual register.
ずるい! — that's unfair! Common kid/casual exclamation.
偉い人 — important person. 偉いね — well done (to a child).
細い道 — narrow road. 細い手首 — slender wrist.
For things, not people. 太い線 — thick line.
丸いテーブル — round table. 丸い顔 — round face.
四角い箱 — square box.
AはBに等しい — A equals B. Math/logic.
ふと思った — I suddenly thought… A subtle 'just then.'
突然の知らせ — sudden news. Stronger than ふと.
いきなり聞かれた — was suddenly asked. More casual than 突然.
ようやく着いた — finally arrived. More literary than やっと.
やっと終わった — finally done. More casual.
ついに完成した — at last completed. Often dramatic.
いよいよ明日 — finally, tomorrow. Anticipation.
Often used for inevitable outcomes — 'in the end…'
まもなく到着します — arriving shortly. Common in train/airport announcements.
Same as above with kanji. Both forms used.
More formal than もう. 既に完了している — already completed.
未だに分からない — still don't understand.
今更どうしようもない — too late to do anything now.
度々すみません — sorry to bother you repeatedly.
At N3 also written 時時. 時々雨 — occasionally rain.
毎度ありがとうございます — thank you every time (shop greeting).
次第に慣れる — gradually get used to.
徐々に進む — proceed gradually.
少しずつ進歩する — progress little by little.
どんどん進める — push ahead rapidly. Onomatopoeia origin.
だんだん寒くなる — gets gradually colder.
なるべく早く — as soon as possible. More natural than できるだけ in some cases.
できるだけ頑張る — do one's very best.
わざと無視する — deliberately ignore.
わざわざありがとう — thank you for going to the trouble.
せっかく来たのに — even though I came all this way. Hard to translate, deeply Japanese.
とりあえずビール — beer for now (classic order). Hugely common.
そのうち会おう — let's meet sometime. Vague near-future.
いずれにしても — in any case.
せめて連絡してほしい — at least contact me. Conveys disappointment.
少なくとも10人 — at least 10 people.
もちろんです — of course (polite affirm).
確かにそうだ — indeed it's so.
あくまで個人の意見 — strictly a personal opinion.
主に日本語を勉強する — mainly study Japanese.
Note: also in N3/N4 General. 特に問題ない — no particular problem.
具体的に説明する — explain concretely.
抽象的な話 — abstract talk. Opposite of 具体的.
基本的に — basically. Common conversational opener.
一般的に — generally speaking.
個人的には — personally speaking.
効果的な方法 — effective method.
積極的に参加する — actively participate.
Opposite of 積極的.
否定的な意見 — negative opinion.
肯定的に考える — think positively.
楽観的な人 — an optimist.
悲観的な見方 — pessimistic outlook.
現実的 — realistic. 現実逃避 — escape from reality.
理想的 — ideal. 理想と現実 — ideals vs reality.
夢を見る — to dream. 夢を叶える — fulfill a dream.
希望する — to hope/desire. 希望者 — applicant/volunteer.
お願い — request (polite). 願いが叶う — wish comes true.
医者を目指す — aim to be a doctor.
挑戦する — to take on a challenge.
競争する — to compete. 競争相手 — competitor.
勝負する — to compete (decide it). 勝負を決める — decide the match.
試合に勝つ — win a match.
試合に負ける — lose a match.
試合は引き分け — the match was a tie.
優勝する — to win the championship.
応援する — to cheer on. 応援団 — cheer squad.
記録する — to record. 世界記録 — world record.
順番を待つ — wait one's turn.
順位が上がる — rise in rank.
レベルが高い — high level. Loanword everywhere.
次の段階 — next stage.
ある程度 — to some extent. 程度の問題 — matter of degree.
範囲を広げる — expand the range.
基準を満たす — meet the standard.
生活水準 — standard of living.
傾向がある — to tend to.
特徴的な声 — distinctive voice.
代表する — to represent. 代表者 — representative.
中央線 — Chuo Line (Tokyo). 中央銀行 — central bank.
Note: also in Japan Travel deck. 街の中心 — city center.
More formal than 周り.
区別する — to distinguish.
文化の違い — cultural differences.
共通の話題 — common topic. 共通点 — point in common.
独特な味 — unique flavor.
具合が悪い — feeling unwell.
調子はどう — how are you feeling? 調子に乗る — get carried away.
状況による — depends on the situation.
健康状態 — state of health. 動作状態 — operating state.
At N3 think compounds: 役に立つ — useful. 思い立つ — make up one's mind.
勉強に役立つ — useful for studying.
More common phrasal form than 役立つ. 役に立つアプリ — useful app.
道を間違える — go the wrong way.
間違いない — for sure, no mistake about it.
勘違いする — to misunderstand. Often gentler than 間違える.
誤解しないで — don't misunderstand.
理解する — to understand (more formal than 分かる).
納得する — to be convinced. 納得いかない — can't accept it.
気持ちがいい — feels good.
気分がいい — in a good mood. Subtle nuance vs 気持ち.
More formal/intellectual than 気持ち. 感情的 — emotional.
五感 — five senses. 感覚的 — intuitive.
感想を聞かせて — let me hear your thoughts.
気の毒に — that's a shame. お気の毒に — my condolences.
せつない気持ち — painful, bittersweet feeling. Rich Japanese mood word.
Also さみしい. 寂しくなる — to feel lonely (e.g. when someone leaves).
With kanji. Same word as せつない (no kanji form).
恋をする — to fall in love. 恋人 — sweetheart.
More universal/lasting than 恋. 愛する — to love.
恋愛関係 — romantic relationship.
More formal than 友達. The bond itself.
Note: also in Drive My Car deck. 信頼する — to trust.
信頼を裏切る — betray trust.
喧嘩する — to fight (verbal usually, but can be physical).
仲直りする — make up after a fight.
Note: also in Drive My Car v2. 許してください — please forgive me.
間違いを認める — admit a mistake.
疑いを持つ — have doubts.
信じられない — unbelievable.
考えがある — to have an idea. The noun form.
いいアイデア — good idea. Loanword everywhere.
発想を変える — change one's way of thinking.
見方が違う — see things differently. Different from 味方 (ally).
考え方が違う — different way of thinking.
主観的 — subjective.
客観的 — objective.
At N3, idiomatic compounds: 目立つ (stand out), 目に入る (catch sight of).
目立つ服 — flashy clothes.
目に入った — caught my eye.
Note: already in N3/N4 General. 気づかなかった — didn't notice.
More phrasal form. Often used in past: 気が付くと — when I noticed.
気にしないで — don't worry about it.
気になる人 — someone you're interested in.
気が合わない — don't get along.
Note: also in Yotsubato deck. 気をつけて — take care.
頭がいい人 — smart person.
お手伝い — helper/help (polite). Also 'maid' in older usage.
助けを求める — seek help.
助かりました — that helped a lot. Common gratitude.
助けて! — Help! Distinct from 手伝う (assist).
お礼を言う — to give thanks. お礼の手紙 — thank-you letter.
感謝する — to be grateful. More formal than ありがとう.
先生に褒められた — was praised by the teacher.
親に叱られる — be scolded by parents.
友達を励ます — encourage a friend.
悲しむ友達を慰める — comfort a sad friend.
More formal than 訪ねる (already in Travel deck).
観光する — to sightsee. 観光客 — tourist.
工場見学 — factory tour.
集合場所 — meeting place. More formal than 集まる.
パーティーが解散する — party breaks up.
運命の出会い — fated encounter. Often romanticized.
別れの言葉 — words of farewell.
再会を楽しみにする — look forward to a reunion.
離婚する — to divorce.
結婚式 — wedding ceremony. 結婚する — to get married.
More formal than 主人. Used in writing/news.
More formal than 家内/奥さん. Used about one's own wife.
両親 — both parents. 親孝行 — filial piety.
兄弟がいる — to have siblings (gender-inclusive).
親戚の家 — relative's house.
先祖代々 — generation after generation.
子孫を残す — leave descendants.
More formal than 友達. Used in writing.
Less close than 友人/友達. 知り合いの店 — an acquaintance's shop.
Romantic partner. Distinct from 彼/彼女.
More casual than 恋人 (when male).
Both pronoun and 'girlfriend' depending on context.
Often left untranslated. 学校の先輩 — school senior.
Opposite of 先輩.
Important Japanese cultural concept.
人間関係が悪い — poor relationships at work etc.
彼と付き合っている — I'm dating him. Also 'keep someone company.'
親しい友達 — close friend.
Common acknowledgement in conversation.
Standard politely-acknowledging phrase.
Note: also in Yotsubato. Topic shifter — 'speaking of which.'
つまり、行きたくない — In other words, I don't want to go.
More formal/explicit than つまり.
Conversation-shifter; adding side info.
More formal than ちなみに. Topic change.
Formal, written. 従って — same with kanji.
そのために is closer to 'for that purpose.'
Adds an exception/caveat. Common in formal writing.
Concessive linker — common in writing.
一方で — on the one hand. Useful for comparing.
逆に — on the contrary. 逆方向 — opposite direction.
お互いに — to/for each other (more polite).
面倒な仕事 — troublesome job. 面倒くさい — what a pain.
Note: also in N3/N4 General deck. ご親切に — kind of you.
勝手にする — do as you please (often negative).
自慢する — to boast. 自慢の息子 — a son one is proud of.
謙虚な態度 — humble attitude.
頑固な人 — stubborn person.
わがままを言う — to be selfish.
